items.text: Understand what Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is and why it matters
Can explain the difference between something you know vs something you have
Know the three types of MFA devices supported by AWS
Understand how Virtual MFA codes are generated (TOTP protocol)
Can explain what AWS Budget Alerts are and their purpose
Know the difference between actual cost and forecasted cost budgets
Understand the four types of AWS Budgets (Zero Spend, Monthly, Usage, Savings)
Can install and set up Google Authenticator or Authy on smartphone
Know how to enable MFA on AWS Root user account
Can successfully log in to AWS using MFA codes
Able to create a Zero Spend Budget in AWS Console
Can configure a Monthly Cost Budget with multiple alert thresholds
Know how to verify budget setup and test alert emails
Understand how to respond when receiving budget alert notifications
Can explain why MFA is mandatory for Root user accounts
Know that MFA codes change every 30 seconds
Understand why AWS requires two consecutive codes during MFA setup
Can identify when to use Zero Spend Budget vs Monthly Cost Budget
Know that first 2 AWS Budgets are free, then $0.02/day per budget
Can calculate budget alert thresholds (e.g., 80% of $50 = $40)
Ready to answer scenario questions about MFA and Budget protection
